name: bots-smoke
config_toml:
# Round-robin configuration. Every enabled player plays every other player,
# once per seed from each side (blue/red), with the same deck on both sides.

[tournament]
out_dir = "runs/round_robin"
seeds = [1, 2, 3]          # 3 seeds x 2 sides = 6 games per pair. Raise for tighter ratings.
decision_ticks = 40        # 40 ticks = 2.0 s of game time between decisions (~105 decisions/side/match)
parallel = 6               # matches run at the same time
anchor = "random-bot"      # pinned to 400, like chess benchmarks pin a random mover

[decks]
# Each seed uses the next deck in this list (cycling). Mirror matches: both sides same deck.
list = [
  ["Knight", "Archer", "Giant", "Minions", "Fireball", "Zap", "Cannon", "Musketeer"],
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- baselines (free)
[[players]]
name = "random-bot"
type = "random"

[[players]]
name = "heuristic-bot"
type = "heuristic"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- LLMs
# provider = "anthropic"      -> Anthropic SDK, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or `ant auth login`)
# provider = "openai_compat"  -> any OpenAI-compatible API; default base_url is OpenRouter,
#                                key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY (or set api_key_env / base_url)
# Each (model, effort) combination is its own rated player.
# price_in/price_out: list prices (Anthropic docs / OpenRouter listing, 2026-11-07); only used for cost estimates.
# OpenRouter model IDs below were read from openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-11-07.

[[players]]
name = "claude-opus-5.5"
provider = "anthropic"
model = "claude-opus-5-5"
price_in = 4        # USD per 1M input tokens (for the dashboard cost estimate)
price_out = 20
effort = "medium"          # low | medium | high | xhigh | max

[[players]]
name = "gpt-6.1-sol"
provider = "openai_compat"
model = "openai/gpt-6.1-sol"
price_in = 2        # USD per 1M input tokens (for the dashboard cost estimate)
price_out = 10

[[players]]
name = "gemini-4-argon"
provider = "openai_compat"
model = "google/gemini-4-argon"
price_in = 2        # USD per 1M input tokens (for the dashboard cost estimate)
price_out = 10

[[players]]
name = "grok-4.7"
provider = "openai_compat"
model = "x-ai/grok-4.7"
price_in = 2        # USD per 1M input tokens (for the dashboard cost estimate)
price_out = 6

[[players]]
name = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"
provider = "openai_compat"
model = "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
price_in = 0.051        # USD per 1M input tokens (for the dashboard cost estimate)
price_out = 0.567

name: counter-deck
config_toml:
# Haiku 5.5 gets a deck built to counter the default Giant/Musketeer deck that Fable plays.
[tournament]
out_dir = "runs/round_robin"
seeds = [1, 2, 3]
decision_ticks = 40
parallel = 6
anchor = "random-bot"

[decks]
list = [["Knight", "Archer", "Giant", "Minions", "Fireball", "Zap", "Cannon", "Musketeer"]]

[[players]]
name = "claude-fable-5.1"
provider = "claude_cli"
model = "claude-fable-5-1"
effort = "low"
timeout_s = 120
price_in = 15
price_out = 75

[[players]]
name = "claude-haiku-5.5+counter"
provider = "claude_cli"
model = "claude-haiku-5-5"
timeout_s = 120
price_in = 1
price_out = 5
# Inferno Tower + Mini P.E.K.K.A shred the Giant; Wizard / Baby Dragon / Valkyrie / Arrows clear
# Archers, Minions and Musketeer; Hog Rider is the win condition; Skeletons are a cheap distraction.
deck = ["InfernoTower", "MiniPekka", "Valkyrie", "BabyDragon", "Wizard", "Arrows", "HogRider", "Skeletons"]
notes: Haiku 5.5 with a counter deck (Inferno/MiniPekka/Wizard/BabyDragon/Valk/Arrows/Hog/Skeletons) vs Fable 5.1 with the default Giant/Musketeer deck

name: classic-v1
config_toml:
# The main Claude benchmark: 5 Claude models + 2 baseline bots, all played through the logged-in
# Claude Code CLI (no API key). Two tracks from the same config:
#   uv run python -m cr_arena.tournament --config configs/claude.toml --job classic-v1                     # fixed classic decks
#   uv run python -m cr_arena.tournament --config configs/claude.toml --job build-v1 --deck-mode build     # models build decks
[tournament]
out_dir = "runs/round_robin"
deck_mode = "mirror"       # mirror: every pair plays every classic deck below, mirrored, from both sides
seeds = [1, 2]             # build mode only: games per pair = 2 x len(seeds)
decision_ticks = 40        # 2.0 s of game time between decisions
parallel = 10
anchor = "random-bot"      # pinned to 400

[decks]
# Classic track decks (names from cr_arena/decks.py). Adding a deck later and rerunning the same
# job only plays the new games. Bots in build mode play these too (deck i for seed i).
classic = ["giant-beatdown", "hog-2.6-cycle", "lavaloon"]

[[players]]
name = "random-bot"
type = "random"

[[players]]
name = "heuristic-bot"
type = "heuristic"

# All models at the same reasoning effort ("low") so the comparison is like for like and games stay fast.
# Cost is the CLI's own per-call figure (list price), not a guess.
[[players]]
name = "claude-fable-5.1"
provider = "claude_cli"
model = "claude-fable-5-1"
effort = "low"
timeout_s = 150

[[players]]
